Definition: The circle on the ground that a terrain tool changes. Its size is its radius, in world units.
What the brush does to the ground, such as Raise, Lower, Smooth, Flatten or Ramp.
One continuous use of a tool, from when you start pressing until you let go. Each stroke is one change you can undo.
How much a tool changes the ground. For Raise and Lower, it is how many units per second the middle of the brush moves.
How the brush's effect fades from its middle to its edge.
How steep the ground is at a point, in degrees. 0 is flat.
A tool that evens the ground toward one height, making a level place.
A tool that pulls the ground toward a straight slope between two points you choose, such as a path up a hill.
